"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"When new content arrives, the plugin **wakes the owning agent** — delivering a plugin-sourced user m"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"essage into the session, exactly like Claude Code's `<task-notification>` mechanism."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"If you rely on Claude Code's Monitor to stay responsive to inbound messages while a shell is idle, t"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"his plugin gives you the same capability inside DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The model calls the `monitor` tool to arm a watcher on a source:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **`source: file`** — an append-only NDJSON inbox. New lines are delivered as they land.
- **`sourc"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"e: command`** — a shell command re-run on an interval. Its output delta since the last run is delive"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ommand`** — a shell command re-run on an interval. Its output delta since the last run is delivered."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"On each new message the plugin wakes the agent:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Agent state | Behavior |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| **idle** | `agent.followup()` — opens a new turn (harness analog of Claude Code's `<task-notificat"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ion>`) |
